hint: WASD to walk  ·  E to look at something  ·  the way down is south

spots.line: The whole country from here, and none of it looks like it belongs to anyone.
Wind off the edge, steady enough to lean on.
A cairn. Somebody counted the stones onto it one at a time.
Bones of something that fell, picked clean and left tidy.

chests.line: A cleft in the shelf with a bundle pushed as far back as an arm goes.

people.name: Vell of the High Ground
chatter: I can see four days of your road from here. None of it is good.
Sit if you like. Don't stand near the edge in this wind.
Fire's cold. I don't light it where things can see it.
Everything that comes up here comes up the way you did.
